name: recent_open_orders
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_tier, amount_cents FROM orders WHERE order_date = '2026-05-30' AND status <> 'cancelled' ORDER BY amount_cents DESC LIMIT 2

name: open_orders_offset
sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' ORDER BY amount_cents DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1

name: net_amount_case_cast
sql: SELECT order_id, CAST(amount_cents - COALESCE(discount_cents, 0) AS BIGINT) AS net_cents, CASE WHEN is_priority THEN 'priority' WHEN is_priority IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'standard' END AS priority_bucket FROM orders ORDER BY order_id

name: string_function_tiers
sql: SELECT order_id, lower(customer_tier) AS tier_lower, length(status) AS status_len FROM orders WHERE customer_tier IN ('gold', 'silver') ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 3

name: tier_revenue_summary
sql: SELECT customer_tier, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(amount_cents) AS gross_cents, MIN(amount_cents) AS min_cents, MAX(amount_cents) AS max_cents, AVG(amount_cents) AS avg_cents FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY customer_tier ORDER BY customer_tier

name: having_grouped_sum
sql: SELECT customer_tier, SUM(amount_cents) AS gross_cents FROM orders GROUP BY customer_tier HAVING SUM(amount_cents) >= 14000 ORDER BY customer_tier

name: distinct_statuses
sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders ORDER BY status

name: cte_pending_orders
sql: WITH open_orders AS (SELECT order_id, amount_cents FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled') SELECT order_id FROM open_orders WHERE amount_cents >= 15000 ORDER BY order_id

name: derived_table_high_value_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_orders FROM (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE amount_cents >= 10000) filtered

name: scalar_subquery_above_average
sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE amount_cents > (SELECT AVG(amount_cents) FROM orders) ORDER BY order_id

name: inner_join_customer_segments
sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.segment FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' ORDER BY o.order_id

name: left_join_missing_customer
sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name IS NULL ORDER BY o.order_id

name: union_all_priority_and_pending
sql: SELECT order_id, 'priority' AS source FROM orders WHERE is_priority = true UNION ALL SELECT order_id, 'pending' AS source FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY order_id, source

name: window_rank_by_tier
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_tier, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_tier ORDER BY amount_cents DESC) AS tier_rank FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' ORDER BY customer_tier, tier_rank

name: left_join_shipments_null_carrier
sql: SELECT o.order_id, COALESCE(s.carrier, 'not_shipped') AS carrier FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE o.order_id IN (1001, 1002, 1006) ORDER BY o.order_id

name: boolean_logic_open_priority_or_west
sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE (is_priority = true OR region = 'west') AND NOT status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY order_id

name: customer_target_variance
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(o.amount_cents) - c.target_cents AS variance_cents FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.customer_name, c.target_cents ORDER BY c.customer_name

name: empty_result_shape
sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE amount_cents < 0 ORDER BY order_id
